full_judgment: 6. The concerned Magistrate did not pass any order stopping further investigation of the case and releasing the accused persons and such an order was passed by the learned Sessions Judge on 22.1.91. Had it been an order of stopping further investigation and releasing the accused persons by the concerned Magistrate on or after 2.4.90 then it could be said that the order passed by the District Magistrate on 11.7.91 was beyond the period of 6 months. Since no such order was passed no question of counting limitation from that date arises. The question of revival arose after the order dated 22.1.91 was passed by the Sessions Judge (Special Tribunal). So, the order passed by the District Magistrate on 11.7.91 does not suffer from the bar of limitation. We, therefore, find no merit in this Rule.
